source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Against the closest eligible target, ranged attacks this unit makes can re-roll their [Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls).

You can opt in to the unit's charge benefit whenever it **declares a charge**. Having opted in, the unit can re-roll its [Charge roll](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step), and its **[charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)** must finish in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of the closest **charge target**.

combat.unresolved: The reading gives one unit the same effect twice, which the rule does not.
